item.title: County Council Executive agree savings as part of budget setting
item.description: Possibilities for increasing council tax next year will now go out to consultation with the public. Lincolnshire County Council’s executive have met to agree initial budget proposals for the authority, that include millions of pounds of savings and reducing the council’s future debt and borrowing. item.title: Medical emergency on Beacon Lane
item.description: Police officers attended an address on Beacon Lane, Grantham in response to a report of a medical emergency, this morning. The premises were evacuated due to a concern around an electronic device. Nothing suspicious was found and everyone has returned to the property. One man has been taken to hospital.
